prompt: Choose the best sentence for the blank.
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的句子。

options.text: Mark the first request as complete so the team does not see it again.
options.zh: 把第一次通報標成已完成，讓服務團隊不會再看到。
options.whyZh: 故障變嚴重，不能將案件當成已完成關閉。

options.text: Add the changed symptoms to the original request so staff can see how the problem developed.
options.zh: 在原通報加上變化後的情況，讓工作人員看得出問題如何演變。
options.whyZh: 前句強調補上新資訊，而不是另開第二筆；保留前後變化也方便維修人員判斷。

options.text: Send a second report with the same description and no new details.
options.zh: 用一樣的說明再送一份，不必加入新細節。
options.whyZh: 原句說新資訊比重複通報重要，這種做法兩者都沒有兼顧。

options.text: Wait until a technician is assigned before sharing that a safety hazard is immediate.
options.zh: 等指派技師後再告知有立即性的安全危害。
options.whyZh: 下一段交代立即性的安全危害要直接打電話，不應等待。

explanationZh: 前句強調補上新資訊，而不是另開第二筆；保留前後變化也方便維修人員判斷。

vocabulary.note: 用來分辨原本問題與後續發生的變化。

evidence:
To: Office occupants
Subject: An update on facilities requests

When reporting a problem, please include the room number and a short description. A photo is useful but not required.

A request marked “received” is in our queue. It is not necessarily assigned to a technician yet. If you find out that a door which was merely noisy now fails to lock, the new information matters more than a second report. Add the changed symptoms to the original request so staff can see how the problem developed.

For an immediate safety hazard, call the desk rather than waiting for a reply. Our phone number is on the noticeboard by the lift.
